source.source_name: ГИР БО — GIR BO (State Information Resource for Accounting Statements)
source.organization: Federal Tax Service of Russia (ФНС / FNS)

parsing.notes: Two-step: GET /advanced-search/organizations/search?query={INN|OGRN|name}&page=0 -> content[] org (inn/ogrn/okopf/okfs/okpo/okved2/region/status + bfo[] years). Strip <strong> from inn. Then GET /nbo/organizations/{id}/bfo/ for the statement list; per-statement detail holds line items (RAS codes: 1600 assets, 1300 equity, 2110 revenue, 2400 net profit), RUB (thousands). Banks excluded. Annual bulk datasets also at /nbo/opendata.

mapping_rules.financials: bfo[] per period -> balance sheet (1600/1300/1500) + income statement (2110/2400), RUB.

fixture_requirements: large PAO with multi-year statements (e.g. okopf public JSC)
org with inn wrapped in <strong> (assert stripping)
bfo statement with balance + income line items

live_test_plan.smoke: Search one INN; read identity + bfo years; fetch /bfo/ list.
live_test_plan.full: Iterate INNs/OGRNs (from RSMP or a seed list) -> identity + financials; or ingest the annual bulk datasets. No key; pace requests.
